summary: 38 new adversarial cases in two new files. 37 pass; 1 is red on purpose and exposes a real defect: a finite price at or above about 1.8e306, or a finite price times a finite count that overflows, makes calculateNetwork throw RangeError in toSatang, so the client calculator crashes during render for a typed 1e307 price. The money algorithm itself is correct under every specified attack: float leakage, truncation order, the 1e9 rate scale, the 20,000 boundary, the 0.5/0.7 ceiling at 1e9 and 1e15, the 0 floor, one baht, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, -0, fractional and negative leg counts, one million legs, empty legs, price 0, and the two zero-shaped networks. Conservation holds in integer satang for every one of them. Fourteen strategy mutants are killed by measured discriminators, and no existing test, product file, locale, or page changed. The plan's A5 claim of 41 tests in the two existing files is verified live.

blocking_findings.defect: A finite, positive price whose volume overflows makes toSatang call BigInt(Infinity) and throw RangeError. calculateNetwork({price:1e307, personalStudents:1}) throws, and so do {price:1e306, personalStudents:1000} (the product overflows) and {price:1e306, studentsPerLeg:[1000]}. The component price input has no max (tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:221) and readNumber (tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:94) clamps only non-finite typed text, so a typed 1e307 reaches calculateNetwork during render and the calculator throws instead of showing a figure.
blocking_findings.failing_test: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/lib/tutor-commission.adversarial.test.ts > A6 finite input whose product overflows > a finite price whose volume overflows returns finite money instead of throwing. Failure: RangeError: The number Infinity cannot be converted to a BigInt because it is not an integer, at toSatang src/lib/tutor-commission.ts:96 via flatSatang:106 and calculateNetwork:171.
blocking_findings.smallest_fix: Clamp every computed volume and guard the satang conversion: `const ownVolume = clampNonNegative(price * personalStudents);` at line 148, `const volume = clampNonNegative(price * students);` at line 152, `const networkVolume = clampNonNegative(ownVolume + legVolume);` at line 169, and `if (!Number.isFinite(baht)) return 0n;` at the head of toSatang. No normal input changes value; the four probe inputs then return 0 money and satisfy the satang conservation helper.
blocking_findings.note: Blocking only because the gate holds a red test. The input range is extreme; if the PM judges a class price above 1e306 out of contract, the PM may waive F1 and the one red case moves to a known residual.
